brief.topic: Ad-Duha 93:1-3 and 93:6-8: you have not been left
brief.audience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on

coreInsight: Surah Ad-Duha reassures the Prophet ﷺ that his Lord has not left him, then recalls how he was cared for before; looking back at past care can steady a heavy heart.

hooks.text: For a season that feels dark
hooks.notes: Mirrors the surah's own morning-and-night imagery.

hooks.text: Look back before you lose hope

hooks.notes: Could read as a promise we can't make.

selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

resolved.arabic: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ ١ وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ ٢ مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ ٣
resolved.english: By the morning brightness (1) And [by] the night when it covers with darkness (2) Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you] (3)
resolved.transliteration: Waaldduha … Waallayli itha saja … Ma waddaAAaka rabbuka wama qala

resolved.arabic: أَلَمۡ يَجِدۡكَ يَتِيمࣰ ا فَـَٔاوَىٰ ٦ وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلࣰّ ا فَهَدَىٰ ٧ وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلࣰ ا فَأَغۡنَىٰ ٨
resolved.english: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge (6) And He found you lost and guided [you] (7) And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient (8)

scenes.onScreen: REFLECTION / The lesson / The surah opens with morning light and night, then reassures the Prophet ﷺ that his Lord has not left him. Later it recalls how he was cared for. On a dark day, remembering how you were carried before can steady the heart.
body: The surah opens with morning light and night, then reassures the Prophet ﷺ that his Lord has not left him. Later it recalls how he was cared for.
On a dark day, remembering how you were carried before can steady the heart.
